papers.title: Variational Bayesian Unlearning
papers.abstract: This paper studies the problem of approximately unlearning a Bayesian model from a small subset of the training data to be erased. We frame this problem as one of minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the approximate posterior belief of model parameters after directly unlearning from erased data vs. the exact posterior belief from retraining with remaining data. Using the variational inference (VI) framework, we show that it is equivalent to minimizing an evidence upper bound which trades off between fully unlearning from erased data vs. not entirely forgetting the posterior belief given the full data (i.e., including the remaining data); the latter prevents catastrophic unlearning that can render the model useless. In model training with VI, only an approximate (instead of exact) posterior belief given the full data can be obtained, which makes unlearning even more challenging. We propose two novel tricks to tackle this challenge. We empirically demonstrate our unlearning methods on Bayesian models such as sparse Gaussian process and logistic regression using synthetic and real-world datasets.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法专注于贝叶斯机器学习的遗忘机制，与生物打印、髋关节植入物或FEA替代模型无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses variational Bayesian unlearning in machine learning, with no application to FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it lacks any connection to expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for physical models.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究如何从贝叶斯模型中高效遗忘一小部分训练数据。
summary_zh.method: 通过最小化直接遗忘后验与重新训练后验的KL散度，转化为证据上界优化。
summary_zh.result: 提出两种技巧解决近似后验下的遗忘挑战，在稀疏高斯过程和逻辑回归上验证。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上对比遗忘效果与完整重训练。

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to efficiently unlearn a subset of training data from a Bayesian model without full retraining.
summary_en.method: The problem is formulated as minimizing the KL divergence between the approximate posterior after direct unlearning and the exact posterior from retraining, leading to an evidence upper bound optimization.
summary_en.result: Two novel tricks are proposed to handle the challenge of unlearning from an approximate posterior, demonstrated on sparse Gaussian processes and logistic regression.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on synthetic and real-world datasets compares unlearning quality against full retraining.

papers.title: Private Outsourced Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: This paper presents the private-outsourced-Gaussian process-upper confidence bound (PO-GP-UCB) algorithm, which is the first algorithm for privacy-preserving Bayesian optimization (BO) in the outsourced setting with a provable performance guarantee. We consider the outsourced setting where the entity holding the dataset and the entity performing BO are represented by different parties, and the dataset cannot be released non-privately. For example, a hospital holds a dataset of sensitive medical records and outsources the BO task on this dataset to an industrial AI company. The key idea of our approach is to make the BO performance of our algorithm similar to that of non-private GP-UCB run using the original dataset, which is achieved by using a random projection-based transformation that preserves both privacy and the pairwise distances between inputs. Our main theoretical contribution is to show that a regret bound similar to that of the standard GP-UCB algorithm can be established for our PO-GP-UCB algorithm. We empirically evaluate the performance of our PO-GP-UCB algorithm with synthetic and real-world datasets.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于隐私保护的贝叶斯优化，与基于有限元代理模型的植入物设计优化无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a privacy-preserving Bayesian optimization algorithm for outsourced settings, but it does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification in surrogate modeling, nor has any connection to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出保护数据隐私的贝叶斯优化算法，适用于外包场景。
summary_zh.method: 基于随机投影变换的隐私保护高斯过程上置信界算法。
summary_zh.result: 算法在隐私保护下保持了与标准GP-UCB相近的遗憾界。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上进行了数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a privacy-preserving Bayesian optimization algorithm for outsourced settings where sensitive data cannot be released.
summary_en.method: A random projection-based transformation is used to preserve both privacy and pairwise distances, integrated with the GP-UCB algorithm.
summary_en.result: The proposed PO-GP-UCB algorithm achieves a regret bound similar to non-private GP-UCB.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on synthetic and real-world datasets.
